rows.text: PIB's photo caption records the Chief Justice of India, Shri Justice J.S. Khehar, administering the oath of the office of the President of India to Shri Ram Nath Kovind at a swearing-in ceremony in the central hall of Parliament, New Delhi, on July 25, 2017.

locator.element: caption beginning 'The Chief Justice of India, Shri Justice J.S. Khehar administering the oath'

rows.text: Another caption shows the President, Shri Ram Nath Kovind, signing the register at the President's office at Rashtrapati Bhavan on his arrival from Parliament House after the swearing-in ceremony on July 25, 2017.

locator.element: caption beginning 'The President, Shri Ram Nath Kovind signing the register'

rows.text: A caption on the same page shows Shri Pranab Mukherjee, 'former President of India', being received at his new residence, 10, Rajaji Marg, New Delhi, on July 25, 2017.

locator.element: caption beginning 'Shri Pranab Mukherjee, former President of India'

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-15 only. The Election Commission's notices, the Returning Officer's declaration of the result and its Gazette publication, the programme for the ceremony of assumption of office, the oath administered by the Chief Justice, the Ministry of Home Affairs resolution and proclamation of the assumption of office, the holder's address on assumption, prospective term-expiry notices, farewells, stylings of a predecessor as former President and retrospective statements stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. The Prime Minister, the Vice-President (including any service as acting President), ministers and party offices are excluded.
